_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), Series 2LKNM Set 1. 27 pages: English on every even index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index 1-25 (each the Hindi of the page after it); every odd-page top checked on the contact sheet and all are Hindi, no spill-over; last page idx 26 English. Index 0 is the cover. General Instructions match full80 (38 q, 80 marks). Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E: Q22, Q24 (B), Q28, Q29 (C), Q33, Q34 (D), Q36, Q37, Q38 (E), all found on the paper and each confirmed by the bare OR in the marking scheme where checked. Section-A keys read off the marking scheme for 30/2/1 and each re-derived: all agree, no voids. Decimal points are RAISED on the paper (Q7, Q17, Q22, Q34); the scheme prints ordinary ones. The A-R instruction on this paper says 'from the options (A), (B), (C) and (D)' where the scheme reprint says 'codes'; the paper's wording is used. Q19's Assertion and Q38 (iii)(b) test the same two-cube cuboid. Opener of series 30/2 for 2026: nothing skipped.

questions.subtopic: Surface Area of a Combination of Solids
questions.context: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the options (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.
questions.stem:
**Assertion (A) :** The surface area of the cuboid formed by joining two cubes of sides 4 cm each, end-to-end, is \(160\,\text{cm}^2\).

**Reason (R) :** The surface area of a cuboid of dimensions \(l \times b \times h\) is \((lb + bh + hl)\).

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is **not** the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
